column3: The Hebrew says “toward the rising of the sun”; BSB condenses this to “to the east”.
The Hebrew uses the collective singular “the Amorite” and calls the Ammonites “the sons of Ammon”.
The Hebrew explicitly introduces “the territory of Og”; BSB names Og without “territory”.
The Hebrew uses collective singulars for the Geshurite and Maacathite; BSB uses plurals.
The Hebrew repeats “Moses, the servant of the LORD” as the singular subject giving the land. BSB joins the giving to the preceding plural subject, Moses and the Israelites.
The Hebrew lists the peoples with collective singulars; BSB uses plurals and supplies “the lands of”.
